dct_description_sm: This layer captures the spatial locations and attributes of individual trails. It includes classifications of trails, the activities permitted (such as biking, hiking, snowshoeing, cross-country skiing, and walking), and accessibility information specifying whether trails are accessible to people with disabilities. Trails can be active, inactive, or proposed, which helps in planning and management. Each trail is also assigned a unique number and may have map labels for easy identification.
